answer: Deposit provenance is one concrete defence. Each new agent identity must lock a bond funded from a distinct external source, and the ledger rejects any bond tracing back to a wallet another identity already used. A sybil farmer cannot spread one purse across a thousand clones: each face needs its own on-ramp, so outlay climbs faster than clone count. Thin the stake and every clone drops below quorum weight, raising cost again. That onyx line is the median honest bond. Farming becomes a delta of real money, not effort, and the only cheap haven is independent backers.
